changelog:
- Initial release of the Value Proposition Canvas skill, guiding users through both Customer Profile and Value Map phases via Socratic dialogue.
- Supports structured research ingestion (user provides evidence, agent maps to Jobs / Pains / Gains, then Pain Relievers / Gain Creators, with user approval at each step).
- Enforces single-segment/perona focus, explicit gates between all steps, and table-based outputs with 1:1 mapping for Pains/Relievers and Gains/Creators.
- Ends by prompting framework selection for prioritization (default: Kano Model) and explains next steps; does not generate UVP copy.
- Secondary mode assists users without prior research by helping draft a research plan before proceeding.
- Designed for use when mapping research, organizing interviews/notes, or validating ideas prior to prioritization or go-to-market planning.
